change.title: Runtime Health State Accuracy
change.defect: The primary /api/v1/health endpoint still hard-coded the old pre-production state even after controlled production traffic cutover.
change.fix: Report production traffic, provider state, real-money state, production_promoted, sandbox_only and external execution flags dynamically from runtime environment controls while preserving the existing health keys.
change.api_contract: Additive/compatible: existing keys retained; stale values corrected; production_traffic/live_providers/real_money exposed explicitly.
